name: bulwark
description: A modern, self-hosted webmail client for Stalwart Mail Server, built with Next.js and the JMAP protocol. JMAP Webmail built for the 21st Century. A modern, self-hosted email client for Stalwart Mail Server powered by the JMAP protocol. Email, calendar, contacts and files. Fast, private, and open source. https://bulwarkmail.org https://github.com/bulwarkmail/webmail

paths.name: Admin Data
paths.description: Persistent admin and extension marketplace data

variables.name: HOSTNAME
variables.description: Bind address. Use :: for dual-stack IPv6.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Internal listen port for the Bulwark container

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Admin password for Bulwark management features

variables.name: APP_NAME
variables.description: Application name shown in the UI

variables.name: JMAP_SERVER_URL
variables.description: URL of the JMAP-compatible mail server

variables.name: STALWART_FEATURES
variables.description: Enable Stalwart-specific features such as password changes and sieve filters

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Secret used to encrypt remembered sessions and synced settings. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: SETTINGS_DATA_DIR
variables.description: Path inside the container where encrypted settings are stored

variables.name: LOGIN_LOGO_LIGHT_URL
variables.description: Logo displayed on the login page in light mode

variables.name: LOGIN_LOGO_DARK_URL
variables.description: Logo displayed on the login page in dark mode

variables.name: LOGIN_COMPANY_NAME
variables.description: Company or organization name shown on the login page

variables.name: LOGIN_WEBSITE_URL
variables.description: Website link shown on the login page
